Question 3
?

Find the projection of the intersection between the sphere x2+(y−1)2+z2=18 and the plane x+z=4 onto the yz-plane.

a
(y−1)210+z25=1
b
(y−1)210+(z−2)25=1
c
(y−1)25+z210=1
d
(y−1)25+(z+2)210=1
e
(y−1)25+(z+1)25=1
Submit
